body: Request90f54b3e source complete, independent of Save As. Tests-first commit153d7653 adds five UNRUN DocumentLayersActivationTests. Product e38caf11 only modifies Layers load/install/select mode publication, no Save As or AppModel changes. Pushed origin/codex/document-save-settlement; cherry-pick ONLY these two commits into recovery candidate, no Save As ancestry needed. Exact API: editInLayers(_ item: PhotoItem?, statusPublication: DocumentLoadStatusPublication = .workspace, activateDocument: Bool = true, completion: @escaping @MainActor (DocumentLoadOutcome) -> Void = { _ in }). A caller uses editInLayers(item, statusPublication: .caller, activateDocument: false) { outcome in ... }. Explicit Bool flows through private load, install(_:activateDocument: Bool = true), select(_:activateDocument: Bool = true). False still installs/selects internally but skips app.viewMode assignment. Default true and open() unchanged. Status enum remains independent. Backend drain, exactly-once settlement and orphan/failure cleanup unchanged. Five tests cover held completion/duplicate settlement/status preservation with false, default true plus caller status, false plus workspace status, existing backend reselect, and open default. All tests UNRUN on B; no compile/GUI acceptance. Source diff check passed; A owns held recipe gate regression, validation and main. B hold, paused heartbeat and writer unchanged.
